export.title: Export this scene
export.lead: One scene, in the same shape as a full project export — small enough for another app to actually consume.

rows.ALL CAPS line: Speaker cue — following line(s) are their dialogue

slash.title: Slash palette — type / in a block

rows.@name: Convert to speech and set the speaker

properties.title: Properties & the timeline
items: Open **Properties** for the beat (goal · conflict · outcome), cast, and content-phase.
The first **Media** image becomes the scene's cover on the timeline.
The scene's **phase** tints its timeline card; connections there write `leads_to`.

writing.title: {{kind}} page — writing
items: Start a section with `##` (or type `/` for the section palette).
Write in Markdown; Preview renders the wiki panel; Source is the raw file an agent reads.

properties.title: Properties
items: **Properties** edits the page's fields, media gallery, and phase.
**Phase** is editorial maturity (draft → developing → canon → archived); **status** is in-world state (active, deceased…).
The first Media image is the page's avatar used across lists.
